p.d: Каждый год в России бесследно исчезает более 120000 человек. Кто-то пошел в лес и заблудился, кто-то выехал с работы, но до дома так и не добрался. Новый проект ТВ-3 "Вернувшиеся" расскажет реальные истории о людях, которых нашли, и о тех, кого всё ещё ищут...
Это серия документальных фильмов, посвященных великим императорам, царям и царицам, князьям Российской империи.

Četrpadsmit gadus veca leikēmijas slimnieka vienīgā cerība ir kaulu smadzeņu pārstādīšana. Donors ir viņa jaunākais brālis, kurš tieši pirms procedūras ir saķēris kādu infekciju. Vecākajam brālim atlikušas tikai četras vai piecas dienas, tāpēc sākas cīņa ar laiku, lai glābtu abu brāļu dzīvības. Formans tikmēr mēģina tikt galā ar savas iepriekšējās lietas sekām.

Jaunai sievietei cīņas mākslu treniņa laikā sākusies asiņošana pa muti, un viņa tiek nogādāta slimnīcā. Mediķi mēģina saprast, kas kaiš meitenei, un tai pat laikā uzzina, ka Formans uzrakstījis atlūgumu un pamet slimnīcu. Kamerona un Čeiss ir neizpratnē. Hauss un Vilsons ir noraizējušies viens par otru.

Kurš gan nezina Reksi - lielisko policistu palīgu. Nu iepazīstieties ar Aleksu! Vācu aitu suns Alekss ir labākais izmeklētājs visā Polijas policijā. Tomēr pēc Aleksa drauga un kolēģa nāves policistu starpā rodas šaubas, vai suns spēs pārvarēt lielās sirdssāpes. Par laimi, jaunais komisārs Mareks Bromskis spēj iekarot viņa uzticību, un suņu puika atkal luncina asti un ir gatavs mesties noziedzniekiem pa pēdām. Alekss pat sadraudzējas ar Mareka izveicīgo kolēģi Lūsiju, kura ir nesen šķīrusies un viena audzina savus dvīņu puikas. Policijā darba netrūkst nekad, un ar Aleksu pie sāniem Mareks un viņa komanda ir gatavi stāties pretī jebkuram pārbaudījumam.

Kaķis, vārdā Deķīts, laiski vada dienas lielpilsētas daudzstāvu nama dzīvoklī kopā ar savu dēlēnu Klaiņu. Kādudien zinātkārais kaķēns Klaiņa pamet mājas un dodas dēkainā ceļojumā uz teiksmaino kaķu paradīzi. Zinot, ka plašajā pasaulē briesmas draud uz katra stūra, Deķīts, spītējot bailēm, steidzas glābt savu dēlu.

Dokumentālais kultūras un ceļojumu šovs atgriežas ar aizraujošu devīto sezonu, aicinot skatītājus doties pasaules neparastākajos dzelzceļa maršrutos. No vēsturiskiem tvaika dzinējiem līdz moderniem ātrvilcieniem - katrs brauciens atklāj satriecošas dabas ainavas un unikālas vietējās kopienas. Šajā sezonā kopā ar harizmātisko vadītāju skatītāji nonāks tādās kontrastējošās vietās kā eksotiskā Kambodža, skarbā un skaistā Zviedrijas ziemeļu daba, kā arī krāšņā Vidusjūras pērle Sicīlija. Kāp uz borta un piedzīvo pasauli no cita skatu punkta -kur pats ceļojums ir galamērķis!

Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši - katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni - vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais - pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

Franču virtuve pati par sevi ir pasaules kulinārijas kults, un viens no tās pamatlikumiem ir tāds, ka sviesta nekad nevarot būt par daudz. Arī pasaules smalkmaizīšu pavēlnieks kruasāns sastāvot vien no sviesta un no gaisa! Mārtiņš Sirmais aicina tuvāk iepazīt kruasānu un tā dzimteni, pa ceļam nobaudot arī austeres un kalvadosu un pajokojot ar vietējiem Normandijas garneļu zvejniekiem. Vai tiešām īpašā franču virtuves garša nozīmē lielu dārdzību, vai tomēr tās vērtība slēpjas gadsimtiem krātā pieredzē, kuru iepazīt varam arī mēs?

Dr. Sirmais raidījuma otrajā epizodē tiksies ar mūziķi Kristapu Rasimu un analizēs viņa ģimenes ēšanas paradumus. Šefpavārs ne tikai piedāvās savu redzējumu ēdienkartes uzlabošanai, bet dalīsies arī ar noderīgiem padomiem, kuri virtuvē noderēs ikvienam! Šajā raidījumā Dr. Sirmais apskatīs piecas Kristapa ģimenes receptes. Ko būs sagatavojis mūziķis, bet ar kādiem meistarstiķiem pārsteigs Dr. Sirmais? Vai ir gatavošanas procesā ir iespējams novest Dr. Sirmo tik tālu, ka jākāpj uz galda? Skatieties jauno raidījumu "Dr. Sirmais" un gūsti vērtīgus padomus arī sev!

Leipcigas policijas īpašā vienība SOKO - labākie no labākajiem, augstas klases profesionāļi, izmeklētāji, kas ķeras pie darba, lai atrisinātu smagākos un sarežģītākos pilsētā paveiktos noziegumus. Vienību vada ambiciozā vecākā policijas komisāre Ina Cimermane, kas kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu Janu Meibahu, Tomu Kovalski un Olīviju Faredi izmeklē smagus noziegumus - gan rūpīgi plānotas slepkavības, gan emociju karstumā paveiktas. Lai notvertu noziedzniekus, komanda piesaista valsts izcilākos ekspertus un labākos konsultantus.

CSI komandai jāizmeklē, kā kāda smalka restorāna šefs nonācis gaļas maļamajā mašīnā. Visai drīz viņi atklāj, ka šajā virtuvē ēst gatavošana nav bijusi vienīgais ienākumu avots. Mirusi jauna sieviete, kurai bijuši bipolārie traucējumi. Sākotnējo versiju par pašnāvību izmeklētāji noraida, kad tiek atklāti pierādījumi aukstasinīgai slepkavībai.

Ieskaties vienas no Austrālijas lielākās un noslogotākās medicīnas iestādes, Melburnas Karaliskās slimnīcas, neatliekamās palīdzības nodaļas ikdienā. Nežēlīgi uzbrukumi, šausminošas avārijas, traumatiski negadījumi un katastrofas - katru dienu slimnīcā nonāk cilvēki ar dzīvībai bīstamiem ievainojumiem. Tad pie darba ķeras augsti kvalificēti ārsti un medmāsas un nenogurstoši cīnās par savu pacientu dzīvībām. Spriedze, emocijas, brīnumainas izglābšanās un traģiski zaudējumi - aiz šīs slimnīcas sienām notiek it viss. Sāpju asaras mijas ar laimīgiem smaidiem.

"Sirmais. Kulta ēdieni" ir pirmais vērienīgais televīzijas projekts, kur galvenajā lomā ir ēdiens. Raidījuma veidotāju neremdināmā zinātkāre par ēdienu izcelsmi un drosmīgā ambīcija iepazīt pasaules kulta ēdienus tuvplānā ir vainagojusies spilgtos stāstos ne tikai par kulināriju, bet arī par cilvēkiem. "Es to daru tāpēc, ka es gribu zināt. Gribu iepazīt pasauli un cilvēkus. Lai galva paliek plašāka! Piemēram, tagad es zinu, ka garneli var izzvejot ar mailīšu tīklu. Ka Normandijā garneļu zvejošana ir tas pats, kas Latvijā sēņošana. Ka tas nav ekskluzīvi un tikai miljonāru ēdienkartē, bet tā ir īstā dzīve lielai daļai burvīgu, vienkāršu cilvēku," par gūtajiem iespaidiem stāsta Mārtiņš Sirmais.

Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi - viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi, un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus.

Īpašā izmeklētāju vienība detektīva Maka Teilora vadībā šķetina noziegumus tumšākajos Ņujorkas nostūros. Viņi ir kā savdabīga ģimene, kurus vieno spēcīga taisnīguma izjūta. Lai atklātu sarežģītās krimināllietas, viņi izmanto progresīvākās metodes, pretstatā tradicionālajiem izmeklēšanas paņēmieniem. Katra ir lieta kā rēbuss, kuru komanda risina, analizējot katru detaļu un pavedienu.

Jaunajā sezonā Dr. Sirmais tiksies ar viesiem, kas vienreiz jau bijuši vizītē pie daktera, satiekoties vēlreiz ar kādu slavenību no iepriekšējām sezonām uz "otro vizīti". Tikšanās laikā abi draudzīgi pārrunās iemācīto, vērtēs iepriekšējo padomu noderīgumu un pārbaudīs, vai viesu kulinārijas prasmes ir uzlabojušās. Otrajā vizītē Mārtiņš sagaidīs savus pacientus ar brīvdienu ēdienkarti, dodot praktiskus padomus un dažādus knifus brokastu, pusdienu un vakariņu ēdienkartēm, kas noderēs ne vien slavenībām, bet arī skatītājiem. Sirmais turpinās iedvesmot ar jauniem padomiem produktu izvēlē un gardu maltīšu gatavošanā, stāstot, kā to darīt lētāk un gudrāk!
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

360 Ziņas ir dinamisks un mūsdienīgs TOP7 dienas svarīgāko Latvijas un pasaules notikumu apskats, kas palīdz saprast, kāpēc tas ir svarīgi tieši tev. TOP7 apvieno ātru tempu, saprotamu valodu, dažādus viedokļus un cilvēku pieredzes, kā arī skaidrojošu pieeju bez informācijas pārslodzes un liekvārdības, palīdzot orientēties informatīvajā troksnī un īsā laikā ar TOP7 iegūt skaidru priekšstatu par dienas būtiskāko.

Kad policija ir bezspēcīga, palīgā dodas Īpašā izmeklēšanas aģentūra SLED. Tā ir īpaši izveidota struktūra policijas galvenās pārvaldes sastāvā un tieši pakļauta ģenerālim - Ukrainas Iekšlietu ministra vietniekam. Vienība nodarbojas ar īpaši skaļu, sarežģītu un smagu noziegumu izmeklēšanu. Tai pieejamas vismodernākās tehnoloģijas un valsts labākie kriminālisti un tiesu medicīnas laboratorijas. Protams, vienībā darbojas arī tikai labākie operatīvie darbinieki, kuri nepieļaus, ka kāda lieta netiktu atrisināta. Galvenajās lomās: Tatjana Kravčenko, Boriss Georgijevskijs, Aleksejs Surovcevs.

Bijusī izmeklētāja Nataļja Dzjubenko un žurnālists Vadims Zorons turpina cīņu taisnības vārdā! Kopā ar saviem profesionālajiem palīgiem viņi izmeklē sevišķi smagus un sarežģītus noziegumus, kuru atšķetināšanā likumsargi izrādījušies bezspēcīgi. Aiz restēm mūža ieslodzījumu izcieš nežēlīgs maniaks Marks Šimičs, kurš saviem upuriem lika izvēlēties - izdarīt pašnāvību vai mirt mokošā bada nāvē. Nu kāds pastrādā noziegumus, kopējot Šimiču. Vadims dodas uz cietumu, lai tuvāk iepazītu maniaku un atrastu saikni starp abiem noziedzniekiem un notvertu ļaundari. Tā kā katrs izmeklētājs ir ar savu spēcīgu raksturu, tādu pat viedokli, un katram ir savas darba metodes, atmosfēra komandā gan kļūst nokaitēta, un sastrādāties nav nemaz tik viegli.

Nepālas ceļojums var sākties! Jau pirmajā sērijā dosimies uz visnotaļ bīstamu savvaļas vietu - Nepālas džungļiem, kur pārsteigumi gaida ik uz soļa! Raidījumā uzzināsiet, kā izvērtīsies saldās medus medības pie milzu asinskārajām bitēm un kā ar masveidīgu rituālu palīdzību iespējams apturēt sausumu, kā arī dosimies uz grandiozām svinībām Himalajos. Bet Dmitrijs Komarovs būs liecinieks nežēlīgam rituālam, kas šokēs līdz sirds dziļumiem. Kāpēc cilvēki joprojām upurē dievus, lūdzot viņiem aizsardzību un palīdzību? To uzzini piedzīvojumiem bagātajā un ekstrēmajā Nepālas ceļojumā!

Krimināli dokumentāls drāmas seriāls, kurā tiek izmeklēti sarežģīti kriminālprocesi. Katra sērija ir atsevišķs stāsts, kas balstīts uz reāliem notikumiem. Daudzi šādi noziegumi varētu palikt neatklāti un vainīgais – izvairīties no soda, ja vien izmeklētāja atklātā detaļa nekļūtu par pavedienu uz atrisinājumu: nomesta matu sprādze, pazaudēta poga vai ielikta zīmīte - lietiskie pierādījumi.

Andrejs Kravecs ir godprātīgs un principiāls operatīvais darbinieks. Tieši viņa godprātība noved pie saķeršanās ar augsti stāvošu un ietekmīgu politiķi, kurš saniknojas ne pa jokam. Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. Un šī komanda noliks pie vietas ne vienu vien Odesas noziedznieku!

Kad policija ir bezspēcīga, palīgā dodas Īpašā izmeklēšanas aģentūra SLED. Tā ir īpaši izveidota struktūra policijas galvenās pārvaldes sastāvā un tieši pakļauta ģenerālim - Ukrainas Iekšlietu ministra vietniekam. Vienība nodarbojas ar īpaši skaļu, sarežģītu un smagu noziegumu izmeklēšanu. Tai pieejamas vismodernākās tehnoloģijas un valsts labākie kriminālisti un tiesu medicīnas laboratorijas. Protams, vienībā darbojas arī tikai labākie operatīvie darbinieki, kuri nepieļaus, ka kāda lieta netiktu atrisināta. Galvenajās lomās: Tatjana Kravčenko, Boriss Georgijevskijs, Aleksejs Surovcevs.

Ieskaties noziedzības pasaulē, kur divas leģendāras komandas no seriāliem "Ūdens policija" un "Izmeklēšanas aģentūra "SLED"" apvieno spēkus, lai izmeklētu vissarežģītākos noziegumus. Šī pieredzes, zināšanu un tehnoloģiju apvienošanās kļūs par īstu izaicinājumu noziedzīgajai pasaulei. Stāsts sākas ar izmeklēšanu par vairākām skaļām ārvalstu pilsoņu slepkavībām, kas vienlaikus notikušas Karpatu reģionā un Kijevā. Vēstnieki un konsuli pieprasīja nekavējoties savervēt labākos spēkus. Detektīviem darbā palīdzēs jaudīga uz mākslīgā intelekta bāzes veidota datorprogramma K.O.D. Tā ne tikai risina sarežģītas noziedznieku mīklas, bet arī nolasa izmeklēšanas dalībnieku emocionālo stāvokli.

p.t: The Crooked E: The Unshredded Truth About Enron
p.d: The rise and fall of the Enron company, as seen from the perspective of employee Brian Cruver, based on his book.
Drama, with Dean Cain. Ranger Jack finds himself in prison after butting heads with Fog, who plans to drill for oil in his reserve, leaving Ben and Mark to come to the rescue.

Blackout is a British TV drama series revolving around a corrupt council official who used to be an idealistic young man. Every new day brings him a new blackout because of alcohol, and sufferings to his family for the same reason. One day he gets his breath and realises he has become a murderer. He wants to tell his dark secret to his lawyer and goes to the court. There he becomes a witness of a shooting and covers an important witness with his own body. He becomes a local hero and people want to see him as the next mayor. He begins a dramatic quest for redemption.

Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

A building inspector arrives at Wentworth to inspect the rebuilding, but he's a fake. Once inside the jail, he knocks Colleen out, ties her up, and plants bombs around the prison. Meg rescues Colleen, but the women have been locked in the laundry with a bomb inside ticking away... Sharon is charged with murder as Alpha Centauri's true nature is exposed in the press, shattering her illusions. Helen decides to implicate herself to help her sister. Lizzie gets wind of Petra and Scott's relationship but vows to keep quiet. Petra tells Lizzie her father abused her, and was going to do the same to her sister, Emma, which is why she killed him. Later, when Emma visits Petra, we learn it was actually Emma who killed him. Lucy attacks Major the dog to stop him finding her drugs, and a furious Joan turfs her out. Ann forgives Wally. Lizzie gets a telegram from Foxy.
Film crew arrives in a small town in Nevada desert. Ends up changing the life of a 12-year-old kid and a friend of his, a movie lover.

John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

Part 1 of 2. The year is 1891 and Wyoming is in its first year of statehood. The three Hammett brothers, Cain, Harry and Dale, find themselves in the middle of a rapidly escalating range war that pits cattle barons against homesteaders.
Western with Burt Reynolds. Three brothers become embroiled in a rapidly escalating range war that pits old time cattle barons against homesteaders.
Horror starring Jeri Ryan. A mother and her two daughters move into an ancient house in a suburb of Detroit, when it is offered at a lower price than usual.

The eighth season of Fear begins after the conclusion of Season 7, when Morgan's (Lennie James) and Madison's (Kim Dickens) hopes to rescue Mo from PADRE did not go as planned. Now, Morgan, Madison and the others they brought to the island are living under PADRE's cynical rule. With our characters demoralized and dejected, the task of reigniting belief in a better world rests with the person Morgan and Madison set out to rescue in the first place -- Morgan's daughter, Mo.

In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

The film begins with an unknown person hiding an axe covered with blood in the woods. It then focuses on Brian Hannigan, a teenager who contacts the police after the death of his adoptive parents, a double homicide. The investigators immediately see Brian as a suspect, because he was in the house when the murders occurred, is thought to have been too calm considering the circumstances, while also claiming to have heard nothing during the night his parents were murdered. Chris Hannigan, Brian's 7-year-old adoptive brother, tells the police that he saw his other adoptive brother, 17-year-old Daniel, an aggressive patient at a mental hospital, walking away from the house only seconds after the tragedy. Although Daniel denies having been at the house around the time of the murder, he becomes the prime suspect.

US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

"The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

BAD DOG! is a hilarious hour of television documenting just how far pets can push their owners and still get unconditional love. The series highlights dogs that double as destroyers, hissing cats, cussing parrots, and the most fascinating four-legged escape artists ever caught on tape. Viewers will be treated to candid animal antics you truly have to see to believe. They are some of the baddest pets on the planet and you'll meet their owners who love them just the way they are. We span the globe to crown the Baddest of the Bad on BAD DOG!.

Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

p.t: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
p.d: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

The Travel Show is a BBC travel programme. The new programme launched in February 2014,[1] and is the immediate successor of long standing travel programme, Fast Track. Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

Сериал рассказывает о работе специального подразделения полиции, занимающегося проблемами домашнего насилия. The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

p.t: What We Know with Max Foster
p.d: Magazino. Max Foster has a definitive roundup of the day's top stories, giving you the urgent need-to-know context, plus a deeper dive into the questions sparking debate around the world.

He's not messing around: Richard Quest presents his hot takes on the biggest breaking stories in the world of business. Watch for the expert analysis, commentary and opinions on the important headlines in the field from the notorious English journalist and CNN anchor. Joined by a cast of experts and correspondents delivering unrivaled facts and news, but also features and fascinating takes, figures and analysis on everything going down in the world of business.

CNN's chief Washington correspondent, Jake Tapper, hosts this hour-long weekday afternoon program, which covers all the day's top stories from around the country and the world, headlines that span politics, money, sports and popular culture. 'The Lead' works to ensure that viewers are caught up on the stories that matter, often highlighting news that may have been overlooked. Prior to joining CNN, Tapper served as senior White House correspondent at ABC News.

Drew Pritchard and Paul Cowland travel across the United Kingdom to uncover classic cars to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. The pair scour garages, barns and facilities to discover collectible cars which include the likes of the Morris Minor Traveller, Jaguar XJS, Rover P6 and a BMW 635 CSI among many others. The combination of Drew's expertise of negotiation and deal-making and Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge makes them a formidable team ready to tackle anything challenging that comes their way.

Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

Motorbike enthusiast Henry Cole and expert Sam Lovegrove travel around the UK to explore people's sheds searching for some automotive bargains. They purchase all kinds of old cars, bikes, jeeps, tractors and other vehicles in order to renovate them and sell after the rehabilitation work is over. The old vehicles are restored and given second life. It is a risky business and the two always wonder if they manage to make profit this time.

For many, an ideal existence is as far away from the bustling boulevards and city streets as is physically possible, opting to live in a serene and secluded corner of our planet. This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

Each episode of Extreme Engineering discussed some major construction project, some of them are projects that have already been completed like Hong Kong's airport. Others talked abount projects that are currently under construction like Tuneling Under the Alps. And some episodes talked about more futuristic projects that may never be done like the Transatlantic Tunnel. Most episodes finished by examining some sort of disaster scenario which could threaten or ruin the project that was being examined.

p.t: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
p.d: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

Mike and Elvis head to sun drenched Portugal where the iconic Mini Moke has earned cult status. It's a car with a very special place in Mike's heart.

In Texas, four competing car dealers, JD Cole, Martha Davis, Ash Rabah, and Tommy Spagnola, battle it out to get the best deals and profits for their businesses. The cars bought, fixed-up and sold on range from many different eras, brands and variants. Some of which include classic muscle cars such as the Pontiac Trans Am and Chevrolet El Camino, to European cults like the Alfa Romeo Spider, Mercedes SL and Volkswagen Beetle. The aim of the game is to get the cars at knock-down prices, restore them to former glory and flip them for a healthy profit. Find out which dealer comes out on top.

Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mil, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis. At the heart of Africa, the Congo for many people will always be associated with Joseph Conrad's early twentieth-century novel the Heart of Darkness, a title that has become a by-word for the country. And for Benjamin and David, two former child soldiers, and Funaha held as a sex slave by one of the many militias that continue to terrorise the country, that metaphor remains a daily reality. The film explores how this seemingly never-ending conflict impacts on the people of North Kivu.

Travel Thru History (or TTH for short) is a new educational/informational (E/I) series designed to spark interest and enthusiasm in viewers to learn about our country's rich and fascinating history by traveling to diverse locales across the US. While it is targeted to a teen audience, the entire family will enjoy watching TTH. Videotaped and edited in the style of other popular, educational programming like Modern Marvels, Travel Thru History is the latest television series co-developed by The Television Syndication Company and Red 5 Creative.

Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?
Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia - the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature - the weedy sea dragon - a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin - the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world - the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters - albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

Pirmās 48 stundas pēc nozieguma izdarīšanas izmeklētāju darbā ir visbūtiskākās, jo tieši šis laikposms nereti izšķir to, vai noziegums tiks atšķetināts. Vēlāk izmeklētāju izredzes notvert vainīgo sarūk uz pusi. Raidījums ļauj ielūkoties ASV slepkavību izmeklētāju ikdienā, kuri neatlaidīgi strādā, lai jau pirmajās nozieguma izdarīšanas stundās atklātu pēc iespējas vairāk detaļu par ļaunprātības apstākļiem. Skatītājus sagaida reāls izmeklēšanas process, liecinieku intervijas, kriminālistiskās ekspertīzes aizkulises un iespēja ielūkoties vietās, kur nupat pastrādāts noziegums.
Elizabete Saldago ir skaista, jauna sieviete, kas pēkšņi pazudusi.

Kā viens cilvēks var skalot smadzenes vidusšķiras hipiju mīlošu bērnu grupai un ieprogrammēt viņus slepkavībām? Ar nekad iepriekš neredzētiem kadriem šajā filmā tiek stāstīts par Čārlza Mensona kultu un dažām no Amerikas šausminošākajām slepkavībām.

Kad plašsaziņas līdzekļos noplūda bēdīgi slavenaais seksa ieraksts, tas uz visiem laikiem mainīja viņa dzīvi. Atklāsim skandālus ārpus ringa, nemitīgās ķildas un cīņu par privātumu.

20 gadus vecais Bērs Diazs sirgst ar diabētu, kā dēļ viņš ir vājš un neaizsargāts. Kad viņš naktī pazūd, līdzi paņemot TV, mugursomu un naudu, izmeklētāji pieļauj apzinātu soļu slēpšanu. Tad pazūd Skailars Tosiks, liekot cilvēkiem spriest, vai šīs lietas nav saistītas.

Alam tas nav nekāds atvaļinājums - Pegija un Mārsija pievienojas viņam viņa ziemas makšķerēšanas braucienā, liekot viņam kļūt par tiesnesi viņu nemitīgajā strīdā. Tikmēr Kellija, Bads un Sevens, palikuši bez ēdiena vai naudas, palīdz Džefersonam iztērēt visu Mārsijas naudu.

Darbs ēstuvē Kellijai krīt uz nerviem, tāpēc viņa nolemj sacelties, iegādājoties motociklu, kuru Pegija uzskata par pārāk bīstamu. Tomēr Pegija to izmēģina pati un gūst negaidīti labas emocijas. Tomēr tieši Als ir tas, kurš iemīl jauno moci, iztēlojoties sevi kā "vieglo braucēju"... vismaz līdz tikšanās brīdim ar Dodge.

Ofisā, kura darbinieki nodarbojas ar papīra pārdošanu un piegādi, viss ir tāpat kā lielākajā daļā pasaules ofisu - tajā ir boss, tajā ir dažādi darbinieki, no kuriem dažs labs vien darbu tikai imitē, un starp visiem izveidojušās ofisa attiecības tādā kā piespiedu kārtā - labākas un arī ne tik labas. Kā jau ar kolēģiem. Ofisa vadītājs Maikls, kuru attēlo slavenais aktieris un komiķis Stīvs Karels, savus darbiniekus ik dienas cenšas iesaistīt savos izgudrotajos jokos un uzdevumos. Viņš pats domā, ka ir pasaules labākais boss, ko apliecina krūzīte ar uzrakstu - "Pasaules labākais boss". Diemžēl šo krūzīti viņš sev nopircis pats. Maikls cenšas būt draudzīgs pret saviem darbiniekiem, tomēr lielākā daļa viņa joku ir rasistiski, šovinistiski vai citādi aizskaroši.

Kāda Amerikas uzņēmuma reģionālais menedžeris Maikls Skots ir neprecējies vīrietis pusmūža gados. Viņš ir pārliecināts, ka ir ofisa lielākais jokpēteris, biznesa guru un labs visu darbinieku draugs. Maikls pat nenojauš, ka pārējie viņu uzskata par diezgan aprobežotu tipu un izturas iecietīgi tikai tādēļ, ka viņš parakstās uz algas čekiem. Ofisa biroja administratore ir draudzīgā un saprātīgā Pema Bīslija, kas ik dienas spiesta paciest Maikla citu par citu vājprātīgākās idejas. Pemas patīkamākā dienas daļa saistās ar Džimu Halpertu, jauku puisi ar lielisku humora izjūtu (turklāt Džims ir līdz ausīm iemīlējies Pemā). Ofisā strādā arī Dvaits Štrūts, iedomīgs reģionālā menedžera asistents, Raiens Hovards - jauns, gudrs, ar sevi pārņemts vīrietis, kā arī citi kolorīti tēli. Ironisks, melns un skarbi tiešs gudra humora cienītājiem - tāds ir seriāls "Ofiss.

Džūlsa un draudzenes ir pavadījušas gadu mājas karantīnā, un beidzot pienācis laiks atgriezties pasaulē. Apmeklējot "TOP 30 līdz 30" ballīti, viņas pārdomā tuvojošās dzimšanas dienas, karjeras izmaiņas un nepiepildītos dzīves mērķus.
Džūlsa cenšas slēpt savu neparasti veiksmīgo dienu, jo Medisoni piemeklē viena nelaime pēc otras. Izija nezina vai afišēt savas jaunās attiecības. Stellai ir ideja par jaunu biznesa projektu.
Seriāla galvenie varoņi ir seši draugi - Reičela, Monika, Fēbe, Džoijs, Čendlers un Ross, kuri dzīvo kaimiņos un regulāri nonāk aizraujošās un ļoti komiskās situācijās.

Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

Катя и Саша дружили с детства. Но их дружбу разрушила любовь к одному мужчине – Артему, который выбрал Катю. День свадьбы должен был стать самым счастливым в жизни влюбленных, но стал последним их днем. Жестокая игра дяди Артема – Валерия, жаждущего денег и власти, едва не стоила жизни Кате и сделала несчастной Сашу. И только простив друг друга, подруги смогли все преодолеть и найти настоящую любовь. На этот раз – каждая свою...

A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher.

"Raspberry Magic" is a coming-of-age story about 11-year-old Monica Shah, who thinks she must win the science fair in order to bring her father back after he runs out on the family. She blames herself for her parents' problems, and takes charge when her mother falls into a deep depression. Set behind the backdrop of a beautiful forest, Monica's experiment uses touch therapy to help raspberries grow faster. She asks, is it nature or nurture that can truly help a being grow? Does it even matter? Through her ups and downs with her family, she learns that it's a complex question, and the answer isn't so simple.

A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

p.t: I Could Never Be Your Woman
p.d: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined.

p.t: The Old Man and the Gun
p.d: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

Joel Reynolds is the owner and founder of Reynolds Extract, a flavoring-extracts company. Although his business is successful, his marriage lacks passion. He is also often accosted by his annoying neighbor, Nathan. One day, a series of mishaps occur at the extract factory, resulting in an employee, Step, losing a testicle. Cindy, a con artist, reads a news story about the accident. Hatching a get-rich-quick scheme, she gets a temporary job at the factory, manipulating Joel into giving her more information about Step. She also begins a series of petty thefts from her co-workers, who openly accuse each other of the thefts. Although Step initially decides not to sue the company, he changes his mind after a meeting with Cindy, that she sets up in order to meet and flirt with him. Under Cindy's influence, Step hires attorney Joe Adler.

Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

THE ZODIAC takes a different look at the famous Zodiac Killer case from other screen treatments of the murders. More than a simple crime story, the film is an emotional thriller focusing on the murders' impact on victims, their families and the wider community. The film follows a police detective and his son who become obsessed with the murders and endanger their family in the process.

Every ten years in an unsuspecting town, The Tournament takes place. A battle royale between 40 of the world's deadliest assassins. The last man standing receiving the $10,000,000 cash prize and the title of Worlds No1, which itself carries the legendary million dollar a bullet price tag. All fights are monitored 24hrs a day on redirected CCTV cameras and broadcast secretly to a ring of high stake billionaire gamblers. A gritty, multistranded action-thriller, The Tournament brings together international killers from every imaginable discipline in a blood-bathed contest to the death. We follow the competition favourites through stories of love, betrayal, revenge and redemption as they finally discover the true value of life

p.t: That Trip We Took with Dad
p.d: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home?

"Vienīgais lēmums, kas tev jāpieņem - ko darīt ar tev doto laiku," reiz sacījis slavenais rakstnieks Džons Ronalds Rūels Tolkīns, grāmatu "Hobits" un "Gredzenu pavēlnieks" autors. Biogrāfiskā filma sekos Tolkīna kļūšanai par rakstnieku un ved cauri viņa skolas gadiem, kad bez vecākiem palikušais Tolkīns atrod draudzību, mīlestību un radošo iedvesmu starp citiem skolā atstumtajiem. Diemžēl draudzības saites un Tolkīna aizraušanos ar literatūru draud sagraut Pirmais pasaules karš...
Divi vecāki vien vienas dienas laikā viens otrā iemīlas, neatļauti nepiedaloties viņu bērnu skolas tūrē.

Pēc pāvesta negaidītās nāves katoļu kardinālu kolēģija sapulcējas Vatikānā uz vēlēšanām, lai izvēlētos jauno pāvestu un iezīmētu jauno baznīcas laikmetu. Aiz Siksta kapelas slēgtajām durvīm kardināli no visas pasaules sacenšas par šo godu rūpīgi sargātā rituālā, kas sakņojas gadsimtiem tālā pagātnē.

Šajā dramatiskajā stāstā Mia Vasikovska atveido rakstnieci Robinu Deividsoni. Filma vēsta par Deividsones 2700 km garo ceļojumu pāri Austrālijas tuksnesim. Kopā ar četriem kamieļiem un uzticamo suni viņa devās ceļā no Alisspringsas līdz Indijas okeānam. Pārgājiena laikā sieviete atklās patieso vientulības vērtību, kā arī no jauna atskārtīs, ko nozīmē īstena saikne ar pasauli. Lai iegūtu finansējumu savam piedzīvojumam, Deividsone negribīgi piekrīt, ka to iemūžinās "National Geographic" fotogrāfs Riks Smolans (Ādams Draivers). Lai gan sākumā viņi nesaprotas, jo Deividsone alkst pēc vientulības, taču laika gaitā abu attiecības pārvēršas īstā draudzībā

Endija Gudriča dzīve apgriežas kājām gaisā, kad viņa sieva dodas uz rehabilitāciju, atstājot viņu vienu ar viņu mazajiem bērniem. Endijs paļaujas uz savu meitu Greisu no pirmās laulības un pamazām kļūst par tēvu, kāda viņai nekad nav bijis.

Kad pēc korumpētā mēra pavēles visi Megasaki pilsētas suņi tiek nosūtīti dzīvot uz vientuļas salas, 12 gadus veco Atari vienatnē dodas glābt savu uzticamo suni Spotu. Kopā ar pārējiem suņiem viņš uzsāk krusta gājienu pret korumpēto mēru.

Džonu pārņem izmisums, kad vīrietis uzzina, ka viņa pusaugu dēls nepamatoti apsūdzēts narkotiku izplatīšanā, kā rezultātā viņam draud 10 gadus ilgs cietumsods. Džons ir apņēmības pilns dēlu izglābt, tāpēc noslēdz vienošanos ar ģenerālprokuroru. Veicot misiju un iefiltrējoties narkobiznesa pasaulē, viņš riskē ne tikai ar savu, bet arī visas ģimenes drošību. Cik augstu cenu viņam nāksies maksāt, lai izpestītu dēlu no nelaimes?
Koledžas amerikāņu futbola komandas ūdenspuika atklāj sevī unikālu spēju efektīvi apturēt pretiniekus un kļūst par komandas spēlētāju.
Seriāls stāsta par četriem bijušajiem ASV armijas specvienības karavīriem, kuri, netaisnīgi apsūdzēti noziegumā, bēg no militārās policijas un palīdz cilvēkiem, kuri nonākuši nelaimē.

Džons ir šķīries pusmūža vīrietis, kas samierinājies ar domu par dzīvi vientulībā. Bijusī sievas, kas joprojām ir viņa labākā draudzene, gandrīz ar varu aizved Džonu uz viesībām, kur viņš iepazīstas ar savu sapņu sievieti - Molliju. Abi sāk tikties un drīz vien iemīlas, taču Mollijas greizsirdīgais dēls Sairuss, kuram ar māti ir īpaši ciešas attiecības, sāk traucēt abu laimei.

Filmas pamatā ir neticami patiess stāsts par federālo aģentu Timu Balārdu, kurš veltījis savu dzīvi cīņai ar bērnu tirdzniecību. Pēc jauna zēna izglābšanas no nežēlīgiem bērnu tirgotājiem Balārds uzzina, ka zēna māsa joprojām ir gūstā, un nolemj uzsākt bīstamu misiju viņas glābšanai. Viņš pamet savu oficiālo darbu un dodas dziļi Kolumbijas džungļos, liekot savu dzīvi uz bīstamas spēles, lai atbrīvotu sagūstītos bērnus no likteņa, kas ir briesmīgāks par nāvi.
Arheoloģiskās ekspedīcijas laikā Buvē salā Antarktīdā zinātnieku grupa nonāk divu leģendāru radību cīņas epicentrā. Drīz viņi saprot, ka uzvarēt var tikai viena suga.

Pēc jauna zēna izglābšanas no nežēlīgiem bērnu tirgotājiem Balārds uzzina, ka zēna māsa joprojām ir gūstā, un nolemj uzsākt bīstamu misiju viņas glābšanai. Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi and shares kimchi recipes, including kimchi fried rice and Korean pork belly wraps.

Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

Selena Gomez and Raquelle head to Alta, Chef Keith Corbin's California soul food restaurant. For the kitchen initiation, Corbin puts Selena under pressure with some short order egg cooking, and she quickly learns it's not nearly as simple as it sounds. Once she's proven her mettle, Selena attempts to make a fried fish dish tasty enough for Alta's menu and the restaurant's toughest critic, Renee Corbin.

Selena Gomez finds a taste of home as she tries the best Texas barbecue in Los Angeles at Moo's Craft Barbecue. Husband and wife team Andrew and Michelle Muñoz challenge Selena to create a dish that puts her own spin on their meat-centric menu. She decides to create a unique sausage containing the flavors of one her most favorite guilty pleasure foods! Selena and Raquelle quickly find themselves in over their heads as they realize that they have no idea how sausages are made. The stakes get even higher when Nana and Papa show up, two native Texans ready to see if Selena's dish can make the grade and the menu!

Featuring 24 talented and fearless chefs who take on 24 food challenges in 24 consecutive, non-stop hours, the 24-hour competition takes the chefs to the extreme, demanding they display the skills, creativity and stamina needed to be an elite chef.

In Food Network's series Kids Baking Championship, hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli will lead eight talented kid bakers through challenges designed to find the most-impressive and creative young baker. In each challenge the contestants, ranging in age from 10 to 13, will be tested on their baking skills and originality as they whip up delectable desserts, including creative cakes, mouthwatering cookies and pastries.

Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

Authors of War examines the powerful role writers and journalists play in shaping how conflicts are understood. Through letters, memoirs, reports and historical works, the series explores how those who documented wars helped preserve the experiences of soldiers and civilians. Each episode revisits major conflicts through the eyes of war correspondents, historians and authors whose words captured the realities of battle, the emotions of those involved and the lasting impact of war on societies and collective memory

Bezrūpīgā brunču mednieka Semjuela dzīvē viss ir vienkārši un viegli, taču kādā jaukā dienā ar mazuli uz rokām uzrodas viena no viņa neskaitāmajām draudzenēm Kristīna. Paziņojusi, ka tā ir viņa meita, Kristīna aizlido uz Londonu, atstājot Semu vienu ar bērniņu. Pēkšņi par tēvu kļuvušais Sems, vēl neatguvies no šoka, kopā ar mazulīti lido uz Angliju cerībā uzmeklēt meitenītes māti. Tā kā meklējumi ir nesekmīgi, Semam atliek vien samierināties ar jauno tēva lomu un vienam audzināt meitu. Taču pēc astoņiem gadiem meitenītes māte tomēr uzrodas….
Franču zemūdene ir briesmās.

Dienā, kad zobenzobu vāveri vajā neveiksmes un viņa gandrīz pazaudē savu lielāko dārgumu ozolzīli, visi dzīvnieki dodas ceļā uz dienvidiem, meklējot glābiņu no aukstuma, kas piemeklējis zemi. Sliņķis Sids un mamuts Manfreds par ceļabiedriem kļūst nejauši. Pēc zobenzobu tīģeru uzbrukuma cilvēku apmetnei viņi izglābj mazuli. Par to rūpes uzņemas citkārt slinkais Sids un, kaut gan diezgan negribīgi, arī Manfreds. Nospriežot, ka bērna tētis ir dzīvs, viņi dodas to meklēt. Drīz ceļiniekiem pievienojas arī zobenzobu tīģeris Djego, kura uzdevums ir mazuli nolaupīt. Tā sākas draugu aizraujošais ceļojums, kura laikā visnepiemērotākajos brīžos pie apvāršņa parādās zobenzobu vāvere Skrets, izmisīgi cenzdamies glābt savu ozolzīli.

Lauva Alekss ir Ņujorkas Centrālparka zoodārza karalis. Arī viņa labākie draugi zebra Mārtijs, žirafe Melmens un nīlzirgu meitene Glorija visu dzīvi šajā idilliskajā nebrīvē saņēmuši zoodārza apmeklētāju apbrīnu. Taču Mārtijs klusībā kaļ plānus par bēgšanu, un ar dažu apbrīnojami uzņēmīgu pingvīnu palīdzību viņam izdodas izrauties pasaulē, ko viņš sen sapņojis iepazīt. Alekss, Melmens un Glorija viņam seko, taču tiek notverti un nosūtīti uz Āfriku. Kad pingvīni sabotē kuģa komandu, Alekss, Mārtijs, Melmens un Glorija attopas izskaloti eksotiskās Madagaskaras krastā. Nu četriem ņujorkiešiem nākas izdzīvot savvaļā, un tas ir sasodīti grūti.

Sajūsmināts par pavadīto laiku kopā ar Atriebējiem, Pīters Pārkers ir atgriezies mājās, kur dzīvo kopā ar tanti Meju sava jaunā mentora Tonija Stārka uzraudzībā. Viņš cenšas dzīvot vienkāršu pusaudža dzīvi, tomēr nespēj nedomāt par to, ka varētu būt sabiedrībai noderīgs ar savām supervaroņa spējām. Kad pie apvāršņa parādās ļaundaris, viņam būs iespēja tās likt lietā!

Slavenajā viesnīcā "Transilvānija", kura pieder labsirdīgajam vampīram Drakulam, viss it kā iet uz augšu - tagad to var apmeklēt arī cilvēki! Taču Draks noraizējies par to, ka viņa apburošajā mazdēliņā Denijā - pa pusei cilvēkā, pa pusei vampīrā _, ir daudz vairāk no cilvēka nekā no vampīra. Tāpēc viņš dod savai monstru komandai pavēli izmācīt puiku kā vien vajag, lai viņš kļūtu par īstu vampīru!

Tafiti, jauns surikāts, sākumā noraida draudzību ar Bristlsu, krūmu cūku. Kad viņa vectēvam iekož čūska, Tafiti dodas ceļā, lai atrastu ziedu, kas varētu vectētiņu izārstēt. Bristlss vēlas pierādīt, ka piedzīvojumi vienmēr ir labāki kopā ar draugiem.
Suņa un robota piedzīvojumi un neveiksmes Ņujorkā 80.-ajos gados.

Ričards ir jauns zvirbulēns, kuru savā lokā pieņēmusi stārķu ģimene. Viņš pavada ziemu Āfrikas ziemeļos, taču ir pienācis laiks atgriezties mājās. Ričards vēlas vadīt gājputnu kāsi, bet šim uzdevumam tiek izraudzīts viņa pusbrālis Makss. Jaunais putnēns jūtas aizvainots, taču drīz sākas vētrains piedzīvojums. Tirāniskais pāvs Zamano sagūsta Ričarda draugu. Zamano atsakās viņu laist brīvībā, kamēr Ričards neatrisinās mīklu un neatradīs Zamano dārgakmeni.
Rasels Krovs atveido bijušo slepkavību detektīvu, kurš zaudējis atmiņu. Viņš ir spiests izmeklēt brutālu slepkavību. Jo dziļāk viņš rokas, jo tumšākus noslēpumus no savas pagātnes viņš atklāj.

Kopš bērnības Eimijas brunčumednieks tēvs ir pārliecinājis viņu, ka monogāmija nav iespējama. Tagad Eimija strādā žurnāla redakcijā un dzīvo ar šādu pārliecību, baudot dzīvi, kas ir brīva no smacējošām, garlaicīgām romantiskajām saistībām, tomēr patiesībā viņa ir iegrimusi rutīnā. Reiz Eimija secina, ka sāk iemīlēties sava jaunā raksta varonī – apburošajā un veiksmīgajā sporta ārstā Āronā Konersā. Tas liek sievietei prātot, vai citi pieaugušie, tostarp šis puisis, kuram ir patiesas simpātijas pret Eimiju, varētu pārliecināt viņu mainīt dzīves filozofiju.
Deviņus tulkotājus ieslēdz bunkurā, lai viņi iztulkotu jaunu bestselleru. Visiem tā ir lieliska iespēja, bet kāds nopludina tekstu, un sapņu darbs pārvēršas par murgu.
Kāds vientuļnieks uz attālas Skotijas salas izglābj meiteni no jūras, izraisot bīstamu notikumu virkni, kas kulminējas ar uzbrukumu viņa mājām, liekot viņam saskarties ar savu nemierīgo pagātni.

Bezbailīgie pingvīni Kapteinis, Kovalskis, Riko un Ierindnieks, kuri ir labākie spiegi, kādi jebkad izšķīlušies no olas, apvieno spēkus ar smalku slepeno organizāciju "Ziemeļvējš". Izskatīgā un brašā aģenta Slepenā vadībā viņiem kopā jāaptur ļaunais doktors Oktāvijs Brīze, kurš ir nodomājis iznīcināt pasauli.

Panda, vārdā Po, strādā nūdeļu restorānā. Viņš sapņo kļūt par slavenu kungfu meistaru, jo ir kaislīgs kungfu fans, taču Po ķermeņa apmēri īsti neatbilst šim sapnim. Un ja tā pavisam godīgi, – pandas ir slinkākie dzīvnieki visā Ķīnā. Tomēr, kad pilsētai tuvojas ienaidnieks, visu cerības balstās senā pareģojumā par kādu Po, kurš izrādīsies "izredzētais" un visus izglābs. Austrumu cīņu meistariem nāksies bruņoties ar milzu pacietību, lai slinkuma maisu Po padarītu par kungfu cīkstoni.

p.d: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

With a focus on martial arts values and a commitment to integrity, the league promotes adrenaline-pumping, action-packed fights that entertain and inspire fans worldwide. ONE Championship not only showcases the skills of elite fighters, but also highlights the cultural aspects of martial arts, making it a unique and captivating sporting experience.

PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

p.d: Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. With sound advice and support from their friend—lifetime Detroit resident and real estate expert Shea Hicks-Whitfield, who is expecting her first child—Keith and Evan buy multiple rundown and abandoned houses on a single block, take them down to the studs, and create affordable, stylish and fully furnished starter homes that are ideal for first-time homebuyers. Now settled in the Motor City, the couple, who have renovated and purchased their own home and opened a new retail store and workshop, infuse every property with a functional layout, artful design and beautiful repurposed furniture. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

Cheap Old Houses is inspired by Ethan and Elizabeth Finkelstein's uber popular Instagram feed by the same name, which racks up millions of views with images of surprising property bargains that are architecturally intact and available for under $150,000. In each episode, cameras will follow the couple as they tour low-priced older houses across America and ultimately choose which ones to feature on their famous site.

Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"
